title: Comparison lower star descends finite local models
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a finite commutative ring, and F a pro-etale module sheaf with finite constant models on a scheme pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There is an etale sheaf G of Λ-modules which is finite locally constant [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values] and an isomorphism from its comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] to F. In the proof G is the explicitly defined comparison lower star of F.

source.place: Tag 099Y, proof of lemma-compare-locally-constant; Comparison lower star descends finite local models

proof.text: Obtain an etale covering with finite constant models.

Define G to be comparisonLowerStar F. Restriction of lower star is identity-on-sections compatible with localization. Over each covering member its restriction is lower star of a constant model. The constant comparison and the invertible comparison unit identify this with the corresponding constant etale module sheaf.
Transport these trivializations to the slice etale sites and apply the finite-values characterization to make G finite locally constant.

A constant pro-etale model is in the essential image, so the local comparison counit is invertible by Adjunction.isIso_counit_app_of_iso. Compatibility with localization gives invertibility of the restricted global counit. Conservativity of localization restrictions on a covering makes the counit globally invertible. Its asIso is the required isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_origin_of_finite_models
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj F) ≅
            (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (W i))
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ),
      IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧
        Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj G ≅ F)
